result.summary: IMPLEMENTED, uncommitted. New Letflow.Identity.AuditContext (from_opts/1, current_trace_id/0, normalize_trace_id/1 incl. SEC-A4 Cc rejection). Letflow.Identity: contract functions count_tenant_wide_admins/1, tenant_wide_admin_user_ids/1, tenant_admin_lock_key/1 (SHA-256 v1 label, bit 62 flipped inside int32 range), lock_tenant_admins!/1 (ArgumentError outside a transaction, bound param), private tenant_wide_admins_query/2 + exclude_scoped_holders/2 (identity); add_group_member/3 (transaction, lock first, group_member.added on real insert only, :caller_audits opt-out refused outside a transaction, unknown value = :emit, rescue -> transaction_failed); remove_group_member/3 (lock, FOR KEY SHARE group, group_member.removed on count 1); sync_role_claims_from_token/3 (SET LOCAL lock_timeout 2s + lock when group_ids != [], reduce_while with per-insert audit actor=user source idp_sync, rescue returns original user, audit_failed logged as tag only); insert_or_fetch_group_member/3 via insert_all count; create_token (lock step, actor/trace from ctx); revoke_token (SEC-A5: lock, re-read FOR UPDATE, before_state from locked row); delete_group (lock in a transaction, FK rescue unchanged). RoleRegistry: do_upsert_role lock -> role by name -> group FOR UPDATE, rescue; role_binding.created / role_binding.kind_changed only over a populated group; ensure_platform_role_binding and rebind_role take the lock first; move_role/6 writes trace. PendingAdminGrants: trace_id opt (normalized) into both bound events, :tenant_admin_lock step after :lock_timeout, membership with group_member_audit: :caller_audits (one literal occurrence). TenantAdminMigration: run/1 under with_trace/1, lock first in real_tenant, audit!/6 trace, ensure_binding(nil) passes audit_context. RoleBackfill: run/0 under with_trace/1, marker reset in a transaction with one role_claims_sync.reset row, classify returns {:ok,_}|{:error,_}, FU-1 moduledoc note. Router: private audit_opts/2 on the six handlers; audit_failed / transaction_failed -> 500 on add, remove, upsert. AuthPipeline: provision_user/4 and bind_pending_admin/5 carry conn.assigns[:trace_id]. Design doc section 10c records the advisories, the CDV-A2 deadlock note and three small deviations (insert_or_fetch_group_member returns {:error, :unexpected_missing_member} instead of rolling back itself; role row locked in do_upsert_role and re-locked as a no-op; add_group_member existence checks now inside its transaction). VERIFICATION: mix format --check-formatted on the 8 touched .ex files rc=0; MIX_ENV=test mix compile --warnings-as-errors: 'Compiling 370 files (.ex) ... Generated letflow app', rc=0. TESTS NOT RUN: free memory 2.22 / 2.26 / 2.18 GB at three checks, below the 4 GB threshold set for this dispatch. TEST-RUNNER must run the at-risk suites (identity_role_rebind, role_registry, pending_admin_grants, pending_admin_binding, identity_pending_admin_grants, tenant_admin_migration, role_backfill, identity router, identity_test and every test calling add_group_member/remove_group_member/sync_role_claims, 25 files under test/). Predicted fixture failures (design section 8 note): any test that calls add_group_member/remove_group_member, a populated-group upsert_role, or RoleBackfill.run on a prefix without audit_entries or not of the form tenant_<32 hex>. Not a behaviour change. Not touched: README diagram (no workflow transition changed), process_instance.ex, migrations.
